rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance, chapter 14.04
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents may screen applicants only by reasonable standards applied equally and uniformly, such as ability to pay rent and ability to care for the apartment. Discrimination based on protected categories, including source of income (Section 8 and public benefits), is prohibited.
rules.penalty: Civil fines of up to $300 per violation, plus criminal complaint, injunctive relief and damages after a Commission hearing.
rules.status_basis: Described as an ordinance enforced by the Cambridge Human Rights Commission; in the city code.

coverage.summary: Applies to housing rental and sales transactions in Cambridge.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Two-family dwellings where the owner lives are exempt.

rules.quoted_span: Under the law, landlords, sellers and rental agents may use any reasonable standard to determine which applicants are selected, as long as that standard is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
